from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
from geometry import fk,tf
LIMITS=np.array(r.spec()['action_types']['joint_position']['panda_joint_limits_rad'])
def tcp_fk(q):
    return fk(q)@tf([0,0,.093],np.eye(3))
def state():return np.array(r.get_obs(cameras=[],video='none').meta['proprio']['now'])
def ik(pos,rot,q):
    def err(a):
        T=tcp_fk(a)
        return np.r_[ (T[:3,3]-pos)*5, R.from_matrix(rot@T[:3,:3].T).as_rotvec(), .003*(a-q)]
    sol=least_squares(err,q,bounds=(LIMITS[:,0]+.001,LIMITS[:,1]-.001),max_nfev=250)
    T=tcp_fk(sol.x)
    if np.linalg.norm(T[:3,3]-pos)>.012:raise ValueError(('IK error',pos,T[:3,3]))
    return sol.x
DOWN=np.diag([1,-1,-1])
FRONT=np.array([[0,1,0],[0,0,1],[1,0,0]])
def run(A,name):
    A=np.asarray(A)
    with open(OUT/'actions.jsonl','a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'name':name,'actions':A.tolist()})+'\n')
    res=r.submit('joint_position',A,dt=.1,cameras=['left','right','wrist'],video='none',include_depth=True,note=name)
    res.save(OUT/name)
    print(name,'steps',res.meta['control_steps'],'done',res.meta['done'],res.meta['reason'],'tcp',res.meta['proprio']['now'][16:19], 'fingers',res.meta['proprio']['now'][14:16],flush=True)
    return res

def move(pos,rot=DOWN,finger=.04,seconds=2,name='move'):
    s=state();q0=s[:7];p0=tcp_fk(q0)[:3,3];rot0=tcp_fk(q0)[:3,:3];rv=R.from_matrix(rot@rot0.T).as_rotvec();A=[];q=q0
    for f in np.linspace(0,1,int(seconds*10)+1)[1:]:
        f=f*f*(3-2*f);q=ik(p0+(np.array(pos)-p0)*f,R.from_rotvec(rv*f).as_matrix()@rot0,q)
        A.append(np.r_[q,finger,finger])
    A.extend([A[-1]]*5)
    return run(A,name)
def grip(finger,name='grip',seconds=1):
    s=state();return run([np.r_[s[:7],finger,finger]]*int(seconds*10),name)
